message.content: {"predictors": [{"name": "Short-Term Operating Leverage Change", "construction": "Change in (Sales - Cost of Goods Sold) / Sales over the most recent quarter.", "rationale": "Firms with increasing operating leverage may experience greater earnings volatility, which could be rewarded with higher returns due to risk compensation.", "higher_returns_for": "high increases in operating leverage"}, {"name": "Dividend Acceleration", "construction": "Growth rate of dividends per share over the past year relative to growth rate over the prior 3 years.", "rationale": "A sudden acceleration in dividend payments may signal management confidence and future profitability not yet priced in.", "higher_returns_for": "high dividend acceleration"}, {"name": "Inventory Write-down Frequency", "construction": "Number of inventory write-downs reported in the last three years.", "rationale": "Frequent inventory write-downs may indicate poor management or operational issues, while infrequent write-downs may reflect more stable operations.", "higher_returns_for": "low frequency of inventory write-downs"}, {"name": "Relative Analyst Forecast Dispersion", "construction": "Standard deviation of analyst EPS forecasts divided by mean forecast for the next fiscal year.", "rationale": "High dispersion may indicate information uncertainty, which could be compensated with higher expected returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high forecast dispersion"}, {"name": "Insider Transaction Skew", "construction": "Sum of shares bought minus shares sold by insiders over the past 12 months, divided by total shares outstanding.", "rationale": "Net insider buying reflects management's private information and confidence in future prospects.", "higher_returns_for": "high net insider buying"}, {"name": "Industry-Relative R&D Growth", "construction": "Firm's growth rate of R&D spending over the last three years minus industry median R&D growth rate.", "rationale": "Firms ramping up R&D faster than peers may be investing in future competitiveness and innovation.", "higher_returns_for": "high industry-relative R&D growth"}, {"name": "Post-Earnings Announcement Drift Amplifier", "construction": "Cumulative abnormal returns over 20 trading days following the last quarterly earnings announcement.", "rationale": "Firms with stronger post-earnings drift may experience persistent underreaction by the market.", "higher_returns_for": "high post-earnings drift"}, {"name": "Trade Credit Extension Ratio", "construction": "Accounts receivable divided by sales, relative to industry median.", "rationale": "Firms extending more trade credit than peers may be taking on extra risk to boost sales, potentially earning higher returns as a risk premium.", "higher_returns_for": "high trade credit extension relative to industry"}, {"name": "Prior-Year Board Turnover", "construction": "Number of board of director changes in the prior year.", "rationale": "Higher board turnover may signal governance changes that precede operational improvements not yet priced in.", "higher_returns_for": "high board turnover"}, {"name": "Employee Growth Surprise", "construction": "Current year employee headcount growth minus average annual growth over previous three years.", "rationale": "A sudden surge in hiring may indicate unanticipated expansion or positive demand shocks.", "higher_returns_for": "high employee growth surprise"}]}
